title: Rust 2015 type `dyn + dyn` wrongly rejected by the parser due to "helpful" diagnostic
author: fmease
body_preview: In Rust 2015, `dyn` is only a *contextual* keyword. It is *only* meant to be active if it appears in a type context and is followed by a token in the following set: {*PathIdentSegment*, *LIFETIME_OR_LABEL*, `for`, `(`, `?`} as dictated by [`can_begin_dyn_bound_in_edition_2015`](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/83adf7e080d0fe4f0970c00eac2976a767dbd042/compiler/rustc_parse/src/parser/ty.rs#L88...
